actions.action: Offer a transparent draft-review starting point
actions.mechanism: A named starting point exposes its exact permission changes instead of concealing an undocumented preset.
actions.implementation: Add an optional “Review drafts” choice with a readable permission list. Apply it only after confirmation; retain access to all 18 toggles.
actions.check: Verify applying it enables draft review but not publishing or billing; canceling leaves every toggle unchanged.
actions.risk: A misleading label could conceal excessive access; validate effective permissions.

actions.action: Require deliberate selection of privileged access
actions.mechanism: Publishing and billing cannot become granted merely through choosing a preset or copying another teammate.
actions.implementation: Require separate, initially unchecked owner selections for publishing and billing. Surface any calculated indirect grant and its controlling settings for explicit selection.
actions.check: Exercise every preset and copy path; neither privilege may become effective without the corresponding owner selection.
actions.risk: Do not remove privileged combinations; make them explicitly selectable.

actions.mechanism: A live capability summary translates toggle combinations into concrete outcomes, including dependencies that change effective access.
actions.implementation: Calculate permissions after edits. Show “Can review drafts,” “Cannot publish,” and billing access, with links to controlling settings and explanations of indirect grants.
actions.check: Compare summary statements against calculated permissions across dependency-heavy combinations; stale or failed calculations must not appear current.
actions.risk: Simplified wording must not omit scope restrictions or conditional access.

actions.action: Preserve custom combinations as first-class configurations
actions.mechanism: Preset labels describe exact matches; they never overwrite permissions simply because a configuration resembles a preset.
actions.implementation: Load existing combinations unchanged, label nonmatches “Custom,” and switch edited presets to “Custom.” Require confirmation before any explicit replacement.
actions.check: Round-trip all stored custom configurations without permission changes; verify opening, editing, and canceling preset selection never silently normalizes them.
actions.risk: Renaming or updating presets must not migrate existing custom configurations.

actions.action: Test the invitee’s intended limits before sending
actions.mechanism: Scenario assertions catch unintended effective privileges rather than merely checking the visible toggle positions.
actions.implementation: For the draft-review task, run preflight assertions: draft review allowed, publishing denied, billing denied. On failure, return the owner to the implicated settings.
actions.check: Seed a fixture with publishing inherited through another setting; assert the test fails and no invitation is sent.
actions.risk: For other legitimate tasks, owners must explicitly revise expectations.

actions.action: Organize controls for complete keyboard operation
actions.mechanism: Semantic groups and predictable focus make detailed permission editing manageable without hiding less-common combinations.
actions.implementation: Group all toggles by task using native fieldsets and checkboxes. Provide keyboard-operable disclosure controls, visible focus, and focus links from summary warnings.
actions.check: Using only a keyboard, create a custom combination, inspect effective access, resolve a warning, and send; verify no traps or inaccessible controls.
actions.risk: Collapsed groups can conceal selected permissions; display their selection counts.

actions.action: Make permission changes visible and reversible
actions.mechanism: An explicit difference view reveals what a preset or bulk edit would add and remove.
actions.implementation: Before applying replacements, list added and removed effective capabilities, emphasizing publishing and billing. Offer cancel and an undo that restores the previous draft configuration.
actions.check: Replace a custom combination, inspect the difference, then undo; assert all 18 values return exactly to their previous state.
actions.risk: Undo must also invalidate obsolete privilege confirmations and preflight results.

actions.action: Bind sending to the configuration actually checked
actions.mechanism: A versioned draft prevents a successful preview or test from authorizing a subsequently edited invitation.
actions.implementation: Associate calculations, assertions, and owner selections with a permission-draft revision. Invalidate them after relevant edits; send only the exact validated payload through the existing invite flow.
actions.check: Edit permissions while calculation is pending, then attempt sending; stale results must not enable submission or supply its payload.
actions.risk: This prevents UI staleness, not authorization-backend races.
